dmn_experiences.title: Cardiff Craft Beer Tasting Experience - Cardiff Brewery Tours (Private Groups)
dmn_experiences.summary: A private-group guided walking tour of three Cardiff city-centre craft beer venues with tastings and commentary from a local guide.
highlights: Visit three specially selected craft beer venues
Sample a range of styles from pale ales to IPAs and stouts
Learn the four main beer ingredients and brewing methods
Private groups of up to 20 with flexible start times

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A cocktail masterclass at Dirty Martini in Cardiff city centre where a mixologist guides you through making three cocktails, with Prosecco and small plates.
highlights: Welcome glass of Prosecco on arrival
Make three cocktails from four flavour options
Sliders and small plates served in Birdcage Sharers

dmn_experiences.title: Welsh Craft Beer Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of three Cardiff brewery taprooms starting at Cardiff Castle, with a behind-the-scenes look at how the beer is made.
highlights: Meet and introduction at Cardiff Castle
Welcome drink at one of the city's newest breweries
Visit three different Cardiff brewery taprooms
Behind-the-scenes insight into how the beer is crafted
